TeachingText: Welcome to Lesson 3! Let's count, choose and buy!
Hello! What's your name? How are you?
Eleven. Twelve. Thirteen. Fourteen. Fifteen. Sixteen. Seventeen. Eighteen. Nineteen. Twenty.
One apple. Two apples. One pencil. Three pencils.
How many books can you see?
Two red apples. Three blue pencils. One yellow ball. Four green books.
Two red apples. One notebook. Three blue pencils. Two cookies.
Put two red apples, one notebook and three blue pencils in the basket.
How much is the book? It's three euros. Now touch three euros.
How much is the ball? It's four euros. Now touch four euros.
Which groups have the same number?
There are two apples. One more apple. How many apples now?
How many cookies did you see?
Give Tom one green book and Mia two cookies.
I want two red apples and three blue pencils, please. Put two red apples and three blue pencils in the basket.
How many apples can you see?
Can you give me three pencils?
Great work! Today you counted, shopped and used numbers in English. Goodbye!
